title: Jared
creator: CrossFit
description: Four rounds of an 800 m run, 40 pull-ups and 70 push-ups. Honours U.S. Army Master Sgt. Jared N. Van Aalst, U.S. Army Special Operations Command, killed in Kunduz Province, Afghanistan, in 2010. 160 pull-ups and 280 push-ups; halve the reps and keep the runs.
